OperationsAIPerformance.label: Label
OperationsAIPerformance.specimensLabeledAs: {count, plural, one {# specimen''s label was} other {# specimens'' labels were}} {category, select, unknown {or contained ''{category}''} other {{category}}}.
OperationsAIPerformance.matrixCompares: The matrix compares visual verification {category} labels from {location} against the VectorCam {category} prediction for the selected date range.
OperationsAIPerformance.eachCellShows: Each cell shows the specimen count and that cell's share of the visual verification row. Each per-label metric is computed as a one-vs-rest comparison for that label.
OperationsAIPerformance.sensitivityExplanation: Sensitivity = TP / (TP + FN). It measures how often VectorCam correctly identifies specimens that truly belong to that label.
OperationsAIPerformance.specificityExplanation: Specificity = TN / (TN + FP). It measures how often VectorCam correctly avoids assigning that label when the specimen truly belongs to another label.
OperationsAIPerformance.labelExclusionExplanation: Cannot be Determined specimens, UNKNOWN specimens, and specimens with labels containing 'unknown' were excluded from the sensitivity and specificity calculations due to ambiguity. An UNKNOWN VectorCam Prediction means that a specimen image was not uploaded. A label containing 'unknown' indicates annotator uncertainty.
